Rahul Gandhi appealed on 14 October 2026 for citizens to provide evidence related to the Delhi crackdown, urging swift action against those responsible.

The former Congress leader’s statement came amid ongoing scrutiny of the security operation and highlighted the need for transparency in the handling of the incident, and sparked debate over the proportionality of the crackdown, drawing attention from opposition parties and civil society.

He called on victims and witnesses to come forward, promising that the gathered proof would be used to pursue legal accountability for any wrongdoing, though no specific investigation details were released.
